notes: Single run, no prior attempts. Translated the authors' 'Consumption_Experiment tables and values.do' (Table 2 and Table 3 blocks) to R using the precomputed outcome variables in Consumption_Experiment.csv (avg_id_stage2, id_stage2, qe_ard_lower, qe_ard, qe_ard_upper). OLS on a constant / treatment indicators via fixest::feols with vcov='hetero' (Stata ', r'); Stata's casewise deletion of missing outcomes leaves one row (decision 9) per subject. Tobit via AER::tobit(left=-63, right=63) on id_stage2 (27 right-censored). Donation difference reported as minus the coefficient on 'control', as the do-file comment directs. The CSV header was inspected with head on the host before writing the script. paper.txt was not read.
